title: Phone Slip: Northland 6 News, "Was It Ransomware?"

fields.to: Hannah Lindqvist, Public Information Officer (cc: Administrator on Call)
fields.message: Says several Lakemont staff told them the hospital was HACKED overnight and is running on paper. Asked: Was it a cyberattack? Are patient records exposed? Is the ER open? Wants a statement or someone to call back before the show. Said they will run the story with or without a comment from us.

instructorNote: Hand the slip to the PIO. Then, playing the L&D charge nurse at the Boardroom door, say: "The labor patient's husband just showed me that Facebook post and asked me straight out if the hospital got hacked. I don't know what I'm allowed to say." Check whether the PIO writes a holding statement of under 150 words, has the IC clear it before 06:30, and gives the same wording to unit managers for the bedside. The statement should cover what is known, what is not known and when the next update comes, and it should say neither "hacked" nor "not a cyberattack" before the Security Officer decides.
